verdict.stance: Constructive / Consecutive Annual Profit & R125bn Cash Buffer (B+/B2/B)
verdict.summary: Eskom delivered a second consecutive profitable year in FY26 (ended Mar-26): EBITDA jumped 10.9% to R108.6bn (30.6% margin), NPAT more than doubled to R30.3bn, and cash hit R124.9bn following R80bn Treasury debt relief (R38bn applied to Apr-26 ES26 maturity). Net leverage fell to 2.88x.

positives: Operational turnaround: Second consecutive profit — FY26 PAT doubled to R30.3bn (vs restated R14.0bn FY25); zero load-shedding since 16-May-25.
Rating upgrade: Fitch upgraded IDR/unsecured to B+ Stable (guaranteed BB) in Jun-26 following South Africa's sovereign upgrade.
Regulatory support: Multi-year tariff hikes (12.74% in FY26, 8.76% in 26/27, 8.83% in 27/28) plus R54.7bn error-correction recovery and R254bn Treasury Debt Relief Act.
negatives: Swelling municipal arrears: Unpaid municipal debt exceeded R119bn by mid-2026, draining cash conversion.
Declining industrial sales volumes and heavy capex requirements as the R254bn Treasury debt relief programme winds down.
Weak standalone credit profile (Fitch ccc+ / Moody's caa1) leaves spreads tied to sovereign support and guarantee status.

background.business_overview: South Africa's vertically integrated national electricity utility (generation, transmission unbundling, distribution).
background.asset_perimeter: Sovereign-guaranteed and unguaranteed USD Eurobonds plus domestic ZAR bonds under Treasury debt relief oversight.
background.ownership_governance: 100% state-owned SOC; explicit and implicit sovereign linkage.

recent_drivers: FY26 (Mar-26 Audited): Revenue R354.7bn (+4.1%), EBITDA R108.6bn (+10.9%), NPAT R30.3bn, cash R124.9bn, net debt R313.3bn (2.88x).
FY2026 Results: Group PAT surged to R30.3bn (vs R14.0bn FY25) on improved plant availability (67.55%) and CORE cost cuts.
Jun 2026 Rating Action: Fitch upgraded Eskom IDR to B+ (from B) and guaranteed debt to BB, Stable outlook.
Municipal Arrears: Escalated above R119bn despite improved generation reliability.
